title: v-model value must be a valid JavaScript member expression

labels.name: :exclamation: p4-important
labels.description: Priority 4: this fixes bugs that violate documented behavior, or significantly improves perf.

body:
### Version
3.1.0-beta.6

### Reproduction link
[https://sfc.vuejs.org/#](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#)







### Steps to reproduce
Access a 2D array with a v-model command in vue 3.1.0-beta6 and newer.

### What is expected?
Access/model the element of the array without an error message.

### What is actually happening?
It will throw an error telling you "v-model value must be a valid JavaScript member expression". 

---
Interestingly this does not seem to be a problem with v-bind.
Earlier versions, including 3.0.11, are working just fine.
Has already been reported in  https://github.com/vuejs/vue-next/issues/3891, but was closed due to missing example.
